row.notes: Recomputes the fitted ratio (Completed / enabled) per department and overall for one Upgrades model and posts it on the message bus with the instance, team, owner and a fitted flag (r8b). Reads states only. Called after every completion, fit (1) and unfit (0).

verify.notes: V0240 reads only; iterates 1 tree (2 in upgrades+8==2 mode), enabled = latest entry +0xc != 0, depts < 4; message carries the overall ratio plus the max per-department ratio (not every department), upgrades+0xc, owner from the latest entry, inst and the r8b flag; 0x143530980 passes 0 (after PendingFitting), the other five pass 1
